task.question: What new service begins on March 26, 2026, in rail transport in Europe?
task.evidence: 26 March – European Sleeper begins a night train service between Paris, Brussels, and Berlin.

answer:
A new rail service called the "European Sleeper" will begin on March 26, 2026. This service will operate overnight trains between Paris, Brussels, Aachen, and Berlin, effectively reviving the overnight rail connections that existed prior to the discontinuation of the ÖBB Nightjet trains. The schedule includes three round trips per week between these major European cities. 

FINAL: European Sleeper service begins on March 26, 2026.
